versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Hulu skill for content, membership, and creator info aggregation.
- Provides structured extraction of public Hulu homepage, membership details, support, and creator guidelines.
- Focuses on membership benefits, package differences, device support, and key content pages.
- Does not support account sharing, bypassing restrictions, or handling private/user data.
- Includes compliance guidance: adheres to platform rules and only processes publicly available information.
